verdict.rationale: Aider is a terminal-first coding agent. The docs cover local installation (pip/aider-install, an install.sh script) and launching it from the command line, where it edits files, commits changes, runs tests and lints. Local models via Ollama are also supported, and community users corroborate using it interactively for real coding work.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a coding agent locally from my terminal

citations.quote: Do this by naming them on the aider command line.
Whenever aider edits a file, it commits those changes with a descriptive commit message.
Aider can work also with local models, for example using Ollama.
